title: Canonical finite open tensor and pullback operations
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $Y$ a scheme and $D_A(Y)=D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ the ordinary unbounded derived category of constant-$A$ modules, with derived tensor and exact inverse image in the fixed-scalar presentation of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], realized as the fixed-scalar category $D_A(Y)$ of [def-sf-open-normalization-data]. Write $\operatorname{tensor}_Y(M,N)=M\otimes_A^L N$ for the derived tensor [def-weil-derived-tensor], let tensorMap and tensorIsoMap be the action of this bifunctor on pairs of morphisms and isomorphisms, and let $\operatorname{pull}(f)=f^*$ be termwise exact inverse image [def-sfb-finite-upper-star] descended to derived categories and identified with $Lf^*$ by [def-sfb-finite-derived-pullback-iso]. The pullback-composition isomorphism $\operatorname{pullComp}(i,j):(ji)^*\cong i^*j^*$ is induced termwise by inverse-image composition [def-sfb-finite-upper-star-comp]; pullCongr transports equality of scheme maps. For $f:T\to X$, $g:X\to Z$, $h:T\to Y$, $i:Y\to Z$ with $g\circ f=i\circ h$, let square be the composite $f^*g^*\cong(g\circ f)^*\cong(i\circ h)^*\cong h^*i^*$, and composeEq the analogous comparison when one composite equals a single map. The tensorPullIso is the canonical $f^*(M\otimes_A^LN)\cong f^*M\otimes_A^Lf^*N$ obtained through the exact/K-flat derived identification. For an open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow Y$ [def-weil-open-immersion], use exact extension by zero [def-weil-extension-by-zero], descended termwise. Let adj be its section-normalized adjunction $j_!\dashv j^*$ [def-sfb-finite-derived-extension-by-zero-adjunction]; for composable opens $i,j$, comp is the unique-left-adjoint comparison $j_!i_!\cong(ji)_!$ from the composite adjunction after identifying its right adjoint by pullComp. Let beta be the canonical open base-change isomorphism in a Cartesian open square [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-base-change]. Let $\gamma_j:j_!M\otimes_A^LN\to j_!(M\otimes_A^Lj^*N)$ be the actual canonical open projection map, followed by the exact/K-flat pullback identification. Let $\sigma_{M,N}:M\otimes_A^LN\to N\otimes_A^LM$ be the derived signed braiding obtained by descent from the cochain Koszul braiding; proetSigma evaluates this braiding before coefficient specialization. Define the right-extension comparison by $\rho_j= j_!(\sigma)\circ\gamma_j\circ\sigma$, with source $N\otimes_A^Lj_!M$ and target $j_!(j^*N\otimes_A^LM)$. The finite coefficient ring is Noetherian, supplying the existing flat-pullback interface. These are definitions of the specified operations and comparisons, without asserting the external-product theorem.
